rows/ms-nm-partial-a.tsv: ms-nm-partial-a: tex 1512-1514 as printed: the representative is the point of the class in the first occupied atom (atomBaseSet, mem_atomBaseSet_iff), every point of C reaches one inside its class, and exactly one exponent of the class does (NM19 c9c73adca; sentence form @SHA@). SUPERSEDES ms-inverses-3 and fk-nm14 partial rows (least-exponent representative), void since c9c73adca.

rows/ms-nm-partial-a.tsv: ms-nm-partial-a: tex 1514-1515 as printed: the points of C with a related point in an earlier atom (earlierAtomTest) form a clopen set, a finite clopen test (isLocallyConstant_atomTest), and the representative set is C minus that set, hence clopen (NM19 c9c73adca; sentence form @SHA@). SUPERSEDES ms-inverses-3 and fk-nm14 partial rows, void since c9c73adca.

rows/ms-nm-partial-a.tsv: ms-nm-partial-a: tex 1515-1517 as printed: the first-atom representative set is refined into finitely many disjoint nonempty clopen cells covering it, on which the occupied atoms at every class exponent, the class (shift) exponents, and all coefficient values at every level are constant; exists_transientCells_atoms does it for the coefficients of a finite subset of the transient ideal (NM19 14babf077; sentence form @SHA@). SUPERSEDES ms-inverses-3 and fk-nm14 partial rows (no atoms on the old route), void since 14babf077.
